bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/pixel_buffer.rs, springboard/sdk/src/display_link.rs, springboard/sdk/src/texture_cache.rs (app-facing), springboard/render/src/buffer_attach.rs, springboard/render/src/buffer_pool.rs, springboard/render/src/pixel_format.rs, springboard/src/gpu/desktop.rs (GBM buffers exported as dma-bufs), springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs (Presenter), springboard/src/bare/kms.rs (next_vsync), springboard/src/media/mod.rs (DmaBuf, DmaPicture)
summary: Core Video's pixel buffers, pools, image buffer attachments, display timing and texture cache are partial app-facing models in the SDK, built on the render crate's format, pool and attachment tables. They are not wired into apps or the shell. The GPU presenter and dma-buf surfaces stay system-layer features, and Apple's IOSurface and CVReturn have no app-facing equivalent.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/pixel_buffer.rs; springboard/render/src/pixel_convert.rs; springboard/sdk/src/pixel_buffer.rs (from_image, to_image, write_image, from_planes)
features.note: PixelBuffer holds the planes of a BGRA or NV12 buffer, reaches them only under a lock, counts read-write unlocks as a revision, and recycles through PixelBufferPool; the Layout description and the lock, revision and pool rules are tested headless in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-08.rs. Gap: no app or the shell uses these buffers yet, and the presenter and media decoders do not fill them; that needs the lab machine. Built 2026-10-19: PixelBuffer::from_image, to_image (under a lock), write_image (under a read-write lock) and from_planes convert between buffers and gfx::Image for the four 32-bit RGB layouts, RGB565, NV12 and NV16 (video range, the matrix from the attachments), so a frame can go through the image filters. Decoders and the presenter still do not fill buffers. Midget check: `cargo test -p bifrost-render pixel_convert` and `cargo test -p bifrost-app pixel_buffer::tests::an_image_goes_into_a_buffer_and_comes_back_only_under_a_lock`.

Pure model: acquire, release, prewarm to a minimum count, ageing past a maximum age, an allocation threshold and flush are tested headless in springboard/render/tests/parity_sdk-tests-16.rs. Not wired into apps or the shell, and not tested on the VM or Midget. The presenter keeps a fixed set of drawables per surface; no pool with these limits is exposed to apps

features.feature: Image buffer attachments and colour metadata
features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/buffer_attach.rs; springboard/sdk/src/pixel_buffer.rs (PixelBuffer::attachments, set_attachments, color_space, clean_rect); springboard/src/media/mod.rs (DmaPicture::colour_attachments, to_tight_nv12)
features.note: The typed attachments (primaries, transfer, YCbCr matrix, clean aperture) are set and read through PixelBuffer, and the colour space and clean rect follow them; tested headless in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-08.rs. Gap: decoded pictures (springboard/src/media/mod.rs DmaPicture) do not carry primaries, transfer or YCbCr matrix, so decoders do not fill them; that needs the decode path on the lab machine. Built 2026-10-19: decoded pictures now yield colour attachments (DmaPicture::colour_attachments: HD is BT.709, SD is BT.601 with SMPTE 170M primaries, BT.709 transfer, the height convention of convert::matrix_for) and a tightly packed NV12 copy (to_tight_nv12) that PixelBuffer::from_planes takes with those attachments. The stream's own colour description (VUI) is still not parsed. Midget check: `cargo test dma_tests` in the shell crate (colour_attachments_follow_the_height_convention, to_tight_nv12_packs_the_cropped_rows_without_padding); in Videos play an HD clip and check it still shows.

features.feature: Pixel format description and fourcc types
features.note: Fourcc parsing and printing, the format table, plane sizes and buffer lengths (NV12, NV16, RGBA, RGB565, odd sizes) are tested headless in springboard/render/tests/parity_sdk-tests-17.rs. Not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on Midget. Formats are DRM fourccs chosen internally; apps cannot register or query pixel format descriptions. Built 2026-10-19: apps can query the format table: pixel_format_description(code) gives the name, per-plane sample size and subsampling, bits per pixel and whether the format converts to an image; pixel_format_codes() lists the seven codes. Registration of custom formats stays out (the table is fixed). Midget check: `cargo test -p bifrost-app pixel_buffer::tests::format_descriptions_report_planes_and_storage`.

features.feature: Display timing and vsync (CVDisplayLink, CVTime, CVTimeStamp)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/display_link.rs (Time, DisplayLink::refresh_time, TimeStamp::time); tests: springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-20.rs; springboard/sdk/src/display_link.rs (HandlerLink, Time::rescaled, checked_add, checked_sub, compare)
features.note: Output times are typed CVTime-style values: refresh_time and TimeStamp::time give nanoseconds at the video scale, indefinite times carry a flag, and the refresh period is queryable (headless_display_time_* and headless_the_refresh_time_* in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-20.rs). Not wired into apps or the shell, and still needs a check on the VM or Midget; vsync prediction stays internal to the KMS path, and docs/bifrost-ui.md (around line 892) records the decision not to add CADisplayLink, so there is no per-display callback. Built 2026-10-19: HandlerLink is the output-handler form (CVDisplayLinkSetOutputHandler): the closure runs once per refresh a tick reports, and the handler can be replaced; Time gets rescaled, checked_add, checked_sub and compare (CVTimeAdd, CVTimeSubtract, CVTimeCompare). Apps still tick it from their own loop; there is no per-display thread. Midget check: `cargo test -p bifrost-app display_link::handler_tests`.

features.apple: CVDisplayLink with OpenGL or Metal rendering, CVOpenGLBuffer, CVOpenGLBufferAttach
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/display_link.rs (DisplayLink, tick, presented); springboard/sdk/src/pixel_buffer.rs (PixelBuffer, lock, unlock); springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs (Presenter, line 147); springboard/src/gpu/scanout.rs; springboard/src/gpu/overlay.rs
features.note: Apps get refresh timing and lockable pixel buffers, with tests. They still cannot submit a frame to the GPU presenter, which the system drives.

features.feature: Texture caches for GPU import (Metal, OpenGL, OpenGL ES)
features.note: Cache bookkeeping only: textures are reused per key while the pixel buffer revision and shape are unchanged, and a replaced name is reported. The caller's function makes the GPU texture, so no GL context is touched by the model. Metal has no Linux counterpart. Built on parity/team-j-core-video; not yet verified on Midget.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/system/dma_buf.rs (Descriptor, Plane, validate, fourcc); springboard/src/bare/wayland.rs (dma-buf wl_buffer around a presenter drawable, line 48); springboard/src/bare/scanout.rs (scanout render buffer); springboard/sdk/src/system/dma_buf.rs (NV12 descriptors)
features.note: Linear one-plane 32-bit RGB descriptors are checked for stride and file bounds, with tests. Passing the file descriptor to the compositor stays a system feature, and IOSurface is not available here. Built 2026-10-19: Descriptor::validate also takes two-plane NV12 (even size, linear, each plane inside the file, new OddSize error), for video frames. Passing the fd to the compositor stays a system feature. Midget check: `cargo test -p bifrost-app system::dma_buf` and `--test parity_sdk-os-07` (the planar-format test now uses NV16).

features.feature: Core Video result codes and error type
features.note: CVReturn is an Apple-specific code space; BifrOSt uses Rust Result and io::Error

gaps: Pixel buffers are not shared with the presenter: the GPU path still allocates its own GBM buffers, so an app cannot render into a presenter drawable.
The display link has no per-display output callback, no CVDisplayLinkCreateWithActiveCGDisplays equivalent, and no link to KMS vsync; the app drives it with its own ticks.
Decoded video pictures (springboard/src/media/mod.rs DmaPicture) carry no colour primaries, transfer function or YCbCr matrix, so the attachment model is not yet fed by the decoder.
The texture cache is not connected to the presenter's GL context: no app call imports a pixel buffer as a GPU texture.
IOSurface-style sharing between app buffers and the compositor does not exist; CVReturn result codes are not mirrored (n/a).
